coverage: RUNNING registers exactly one unique key without start and delivers the assigned preview.
Lost registration followed by lost resume reconciles both mutations using environment state and the attempt key, without duplicate mutations.
Acknowledged registration that races suspension resumes the same environment with the already-confirmed key.
Authorization, quota, explicit operation errors and malformed operations stop without a start fallback.
Even an acknowledged operation must expose this attempt key before delivery or resume.
Registration and suspension recovery share one deadline, including slow completed responses.
Transient polling keeps the same operation; SSH failure still removes provider and local ephemeral keys.
Existing cold-start recovery, auth/quota, polling limits, deadline and compute observations remain covered.
